prompt: Write the body (about 120 words) of a letter of representation from a personal injury lawyer to an auto insurer. The client was hurt in a rear-end collision. Ask that all contact go through the law firm, ask for the policy limits, and ask the insurer to keep all evidence. No salutation, no signature, no names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1418; do not mention it.)
text:
This letter confirms that our firm now represents the injured party in connection with the rear-end collision described in your file. Our client sustained injuries in this incident and is currently receiving medical treatment. Please direct all further communications regarding this matter to our office and do not contact our client directly, whether by telephone, mail, email, or in person.

We request that you provide the bodily injury liability policy limits applicable to the at-fault driver, along with written confirmation of the coverage in force on the date of loss. If any other policies, including excess or umbrella coverage, may apply, please identify them as well.

We also ask that your company preserve all evidence relating to this collision. This includes photographs, dash camera or telematics data, recorded statements, adjuster notes, claim file materials, vehicle inspection reports, and any repair or salvage records. Please ensure that no such materials are altered, discarded, or destroyed while this claim is pending.

We look forward to your prompt response and to resolving this matter efficiently.
